sources.title: Frédéric Cérou, Pierre Del Moral, and Arnaud Guyader, A nonasymptotic theorem for unnormalized Feynman–Kac particle models
sources.locator: Complete 21-page paper; Theorem 1.5 and §5 on finite-particle relative mean-square bounds and their domination hypotheses.
sources.reading_verification: Inspected the complete 21-page paper and read Theorem 1.5 with all assumptions and proof dependencies, plus §5. Its nonasymptotic result uses explicit potential-ratio and iterated-kernel domination assumptions. Those assumptions are not present in the RARE1 conditional-mean-only contract, and the local two-state counterexample shows that contract cannot hold as stated.
